hint.editor: Select and copy (Ctrl+C) the text you want to work with, then press Ctrl+Space — or mention a file in your request, e.g. "Summarise contract.docx"
hint.browser: Select and copy (Ctrl+C) text on the page, then press Ctrl+Space to rewrite, translate, or summarise it — or mention a file, e.g. "Compare this with Q2.xlsx"
hint.email: Select and copy (Ctrl+C) text from an email, then press Ctrl+Space to rewrite or summarise it — or ask me to draft something, e.g. "Write a follow-up based on offer.docx"
hint.spreadsheet: Select and copy (Ctrl+C) cells, then press Ctrl+Space to analyse or format — or compare files without opening them, e.g. "Compare Q1.xlsx with Q2.xlsx"
hint.pdf: Select and copy (Ctrl+C) text from the PDF, then press Ctrl+Space to work with it — or ask directly, e.g. "Summarise report.pdf"
hint.code: Select and copy (Ctrl+C) the code you want to explain, fix, or rewrite, then press Ctrl+Space — or mention a file, e.g. "Review logic in utils.ts"
hint.explorer: You can work with files directly — try "Summarise report.pdf" or "Compare Q1.xlsx with Q2.xlsx" without opening them
hint.generic: Select and copy (Ctrl+C) any text, then press Ctrl+Space to work with it — or mention a file in your request, e.g. "Summarise notes.docx"
